task.title: Discover workflow runs by exact lifecycle status
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/727 with a deterministic recovery query over the unified workflow-run status projection.
acceptance_criteria: Return only exact WorkflowRunStatus matches in ascending exact run-ID order.
Cover active, paused, authored-terminal, cancelled, and failed runs with mixed task attribution.
Remain deterministic after reopen and return an empty result when no run has the requested status.
Fail the complete query on malformed candidate history without mutating runs or inferring external state.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused workflow-run-store target failed because WorkflowRunStore::list_by_status did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added every-status, exact-filter, ascending-order, mixed-attribution, reopen, empty-match, and malformed-history tests.

attempts.summary: Implemented status discovery over authoritative projections.
attempts.diagnostic: Reusing list and WorkflowRun::status preserved validated lifecycle precedence and all-or-nothing replay without adding an index or another classifier.
attempts.patch: Added list_by_status and documented exact query semantics and non-authority boundaries in ADR-0016 and the milestone list.

attempts.summary: Held the exact head through false-green review limits.
attempts.diagnostic: Several successful CodeRabbit statuses explicitly reported Review limit reached or lacked genuine substantive review evidence, so the repository verifier correctly kept auto-merge unarmed.
attempts.patch: Preserved the verified branch, rebased onto the merge-readiness process fix, waited for genuine exact-head summary evidence, then required successful Rust quality and zero unresolved threads before merge.

outcome.summary: Callers can deterministically recover workflow runs in one exact projected lifecycle status, and the slice demonstrated fail-closed exact-head review gating under repeated false-green rate limits.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test workflow_run_store

lessons: Status queries should reuse the authoritative aggregate projector rather than duplicate lifecycle precedence.
Exact status filtering remains historical read authority and does not imply execution, scheduling, retry, or recovery authority.
Associated and unassociated runs belong in the same lifecycle query because attribution is independent of status.
Preserving a verified exact head is preferable to racing a review cooldown or treating a false-green status as substantive evidence.
A repository-owned readiness verifier makes the review policy observable and fail closed.
